title: Indian Oil Giant ONGC Eyes Return to Syrian Operations
summary: India’s state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has said it is prepared to restart upstream operations in Syria once “normalcy” returns, according to The National. Executives from ONGC Videsh Ltd, the company’s overseas arm, confirmed they are monitoring developments closely and would move to re-enter the Syrian sector if political stability and security conditions permit. The disclosure marks the first public signal in over a decade that ONGC could resume activities in Syria, where it previously held stakes in…
